attempts.summary: Pinned curl to its current version on node1 using dnf versionlock (after resolving a GPG key import issue blocking the plugin install), verified curl is excluded from a simulated dnf update while libcurl (a separate package) still updates normally, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, restarted node1 via shutdown -r now, confirmed the boot ID changed after the node came back, and re-verified curl's version and the versionlock entry survived the reboot.
